query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM managed_evaluation_attestations a JOIN managed_dependency_verifications v ON v.owner_id=a.owner_id AND v.revision_id=a.revision_id AND v.commit_sha=a.source_commit AND v.bundle_digest=a.bundle_digest WHERE a.owner_id=$1 AND a.resource_id=$2 AND a.revision_id=$3 AND a.bundle_digest=$4 AND a.experiment_id=$5)
